stories.title: Charles Spencer: “La tragedia de la familia real fue no saber abrazar la oportunidad de mi hermana Diana”

en.title: Charles Spencer: "The tragedy of the royal family was not knowing how to embrace the opportunity of my sister Diana"
en.summary: Charles Spencer, Lady Diana's brother, is releasing a book ahead of the 30th anniversary of her death that criticizes King Charles III. Spencer states he intentionally withheld some controversial material despite wanting to provoke discussion.

stories.title: María Corina Machado ha intentado regresar siete veces a Venezuela sin conseguirlo

en.title: María Corina Machado has attempted to return to Venezuela seven times without succeeding
en.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado made seven failed attempts to return to Venezuela within 24 hours, with routes by sea and air from Panama and Caribbean islands blocked successively.

stories.title: Trump y Delcy escenifican su alianza en Nueva York mientras se frustra el retorno de Machado

en.title: Trump and Delcy stage their alliance in New York while Machado's return is frustrated
en.summary: Donald Trump and Venezuelan interim president Delcy Rodríguez met in person at the UN General Assembly reception while opposition leader María Corina Machado's attempts to return to Venezuela were blocked.

stories.title: María Corina Machado intenta entrar tres veces en Venezuela mientras Delcy Rodríguez está en la ONU

en.title: María Corina Machado attempts to enter Venezuela three times while Delcy Rodríguez is at the UN
en.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado attempted multiple entries to Venezuela using a Panamanian passport on a flight from Curaçao while the interim president attended the United Nations.

stories.title: Trump y Delcy Rodríguez sellan el deshielo entre Caracas y Washington con un encuentro a puerta cerrada en Nueva York

en.title: Trump and Delcy Rodríguez seal thaw between Caracas and Washington with closed-door meeting in New York
en.summary: Venezuela's leader attended Trump's UN speech where he called Maduro a "criminal dictator" and referenced Venezuela's oil as a prize to seize. The two held a private meeting afterward.

stories.title: Sánchez acusa en la CNN a los socios europeos de «insolidaridad» con Ceuta y admite por primera vez que Rabat «falló»

en.title: Sánchez accuses European partners on CNN of 'lack of solidarity' with Ceuta and admits for the first time that Rabat 'failed'
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez stated in a CNN interview that the European Union showed insufficient solidarity during the Ceuta crisis and acknowledged Morocco's role in the situation.

stories.title: Trump afirma que funcionarios estadounidenses e iraníes se reunieron el martes, poco después de advertir que podría "aniquilar" a Irán

en.title: Trump says U.S. and Iranian officials met Tuesday, shortly after warning he could "annihilate" Iran
en.summary: Trump stated that American and Iranian representatives held meetings while characterizing Iran's leadership as weak and desperate rather than strong and confident.

stories.title: Trump amenaza con aniquilar Irán en un discurso en la Asamblea General de la ONU con tintes electorales

en.title: Trump threatens to annihilate Iran in UN General Assembly speech with electoral undertones
en.summary: Trump told the UN that an ongoing conflict lasting seven months would end after November elections, despite his earlier pledge that it would be brief.

stories.title: Sánchez reconoce por primera vez que falló el “control fronterizo” de Marruecos en el asalto a Ceuta

en.title: Sánchez acknowledges for the first time Morocco's failed "border control" in the assault on Ceuta
en.summary: Spain's prime minister expressed concern in New York about insufficient EU solidarity regarding the Ceuta incident, contrasting it with Spain's support for Italy during the Lampedusa crisis.

stories.title: Sánchez asegura que ha pedido “acciones” a Marruecos “porque su control de fronteras falló” en Ceuta

en.title: Sánchez assures he has demanded "action" from Morocco "because its border control failed" in Ceuta
en.summary: Spain's prime minister told CNN that Morocco bears responsibility for the July 30-31 border incursion in Ceuta, while maintaining that bilateral relations remain good.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez saluda a Pedro Sánchez en la ONU y le pide seguir hablando sobre la Venezuela

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez greets Pedro Sánchez at the UN and asks him to continue discussing Venezuela
en.summary: Venezuela's leadership greeted Spain's president at the United Nations and requested ongoing dialogue. The Spanish government expressed commitment to the country's future.

stories.title: Trump afirma en la ONU que “hace la paz”, pero no descarta “aniquilar” a Irán

en.title: Trump says at UN that he "makes peace" but does not rule out "annihilating" Iran
en.summary: Trump spoke for 37 minutes at the UN podium defending his country's strength and justifying his intention to establish global order for citizens' security.

stories.title: La UE acelera su diversificación comercial con un pacto con Filipinas

en.title: The EU accelerates its commercial diversification with a pact with Philippines
en.summary: The European Union is pursuing new trade partners to create additional routes for its companies and mitigate risks from political volatility. The agreement includes tariff reductions of up to 94 percent across all goods.

stories.title: Santander anticipa el final del deterioro crediticio en Brasil

en.title: Santander anticipates the end of credit deterioration in Brazil
en.summary: Santander expects an improvement in credit quality and is pursuing greater portfolio diversification by focusing more on high-income customers.

stories.title: Santander, Blackstone y Pollen impulsan la venta de créditos morosos a particulares

en.title: Santander, Blackstone and Pollen drive the sale of non-performing loans to individuals
en.summary: Santander, Blackstone and Pollen Street are currently marketing over 4,300 unpaid loans through digital platforms accessible to the general public.

stories.title: El Corte Inglés relanza su negocio de energía y alarmas con Hogar 360

en.title: El Corte Inglés relaunches its energy and alarm business with Hogar 360
en.summary: El Corte Inglés has launched Hogar360 to jointly market its security and energy services, which already have over 100,000 customers.

stories.title: Iberdrola busca nuevo socio para su eólica en Reino Unido

en.title: Iberdrola seeks new partner for its wind farm in United Kingdom
en.summary: Spanish energy company Iberdrola plans to sell up to 49% stake in its East Anglia Two wind project in the coming weeks, with Bank of America and BBVA advising on the transaction.
